label: Guangdong: Doumen to Zhuhai, Qingxin to Qingyuan
why: Two players (feedback 1795180502-98e64801 and the board's 1795455528-5b8a2b8e) point at Doumen, a district of Zhuhai, in Taishan's zone (tis, Jiangmen), and Qingxin, a district of Qingyuan, in Sihui's zone (sih, Zhaoqing) instead of with Qingcheng, Qingyuan's centre (qnc). Doumen joins Zhuhai's metro (zhu) and Qingxin joins qnc, named Qingyuan; Taishan keeps Taishan City, Sihui keeps Sihui and Guangning.
